title: 切换CRD存储版本并保留双版本读写兼容
body:
## 环境与初始材料
平台隔离API/etcd预置旧存储版本和历史对象，无节点或控制器。

## 操作任务
平台已预置以v1beta1存储的WebApp和一份历史对象。修复crd.json：v1与v1beta1都served，只有v1为storage，保持两个版本既有同构schema、身份、scope和status子资源。使用None转换，不接Webhook。只修改served/storage/None转换声明，可调整版本顺序，不能删历史版本或写status.storedVersions。JSON小于32KiB且无重复键。
验收会在既有API上更新你的CRD，分别通过两个版本读取、创建和条件更新同一对象，再模拟关闭旧served端点；对象UID和数据必须保持，过期resourceVersion必须冲突。storedVersions保留历史版本是预期结果，不代表所有历史对象已经迁移。学员只在网页编辑配置，无需另开集群。

## 产物
crd.json完整清单。

## 验收方法
真实双版本创建/读取/更新、UID/RV关联、409冲突、退役端点404及历史storedVersions保留。仅同构None转换，不测试异构转换或集群存储迁移。

files.fixtures/migration-contract.txt: The isolated API starts with v1beta1 as storage and an existing legacy object. Submit v1 storage with BOTH endpoints served and unchanged identical schemas. No webhook. StoredVersions is history, not a completed migration certificate.

import copy,hashlib,json,sys,time
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent))
from envtest_control_plane import ControlPlane
ROOT=Path.cwd();assert hashlib.sha256((ROOT/'fixtures/migration-contract.txt').read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='3b4efc9f6f5bffec485610fb2361b3a35aeb7b7b34c08db15f55c4045a7d7e02'
def pairs(items):
    out={}
    for k,v in items:assert k not in out,'duplicate JSON key';out[k]=v
    return out
p=ROOT/'crd.json';assert p.stat().st_size<32768
crd=json.loads(p.read_text(),object_pairs_hook=pairs);baseline={'apiVersion': 'apiextensions.k8s.io/v1', 'kind': 'CustomResourceDefinition', 'metadata': {'name': 'webapps.training.example.com'}, 'spec': {'group': 'training.example.com', 'scope': 'Namespaced', 'names': {'plural': 'webapps', 'singular': 'webapp', 'kind': 'WebApp'}, 'versions': [{'name': 'v1', 'served': True, 'storage': True, 'schema': {'openAPIV3Schema': {'type': 'object', 'properties': {'spec': {'type': 'object', 'properties': {'replicas': {'type': 'integer', 'minimum': 0}}}, 'status': {'type': 'object', 'properties': {'replicas': {'type': 'integer'}, 'selector': {'type': 'string'}}}}}}, 'subresources': {'status': {}}}, {'name': 'v1beta1', 'served': True, 'storage': False, 'schema': {'openAPIV3Schema': {'type': 'object', 'properties': {'spec': {'type': 'object', 'properties': {'replicas': {'type': 'integer', 'minimum': 0}}}, 'status': {'type': 'object', 'properties': {'replicas': {'type': 'integer'}, 'selector': {'type': 'string'}}}}}}, 'subresources': {'status': {}}}], 'conversion': {'strategy': 'None'}}}
assert crd.get('spec',{}).get('conversion',{'strategy':'None'})=={'strategy':'None'},'No conversion webhook or external access'
def invariant(obj):
    obj=copy.deepcopy(obj);obj['spec'].pop('conversion',None)
    versions=obj['spec']['versions'];assert len(versions)==2 and {v['name'] for v in versions}=={'v1','v1beta1'}
    for v in versions:v.pop('served',None);v.pop('storage',None)
    obj['spec']['versions']=sorted(versions,key=lambda v:v['name'])
    return json.dumps(obj,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),allow_nan=False)
assert invariant(crd)==invariant(baseline),'Only served/storage and None conversion declarations may change'
CRDS='/apis/apiextensions.k8s.io/v1/customresourcedefinitions';CRD=CRDS+'/webapps.training.example.com'
def collection(version):return '/apis/training.example.com/'+version+'/namespaces/training/webapps'
def endpoint(version,name='legacy'):return collection(version)+'/'+name
def specobj(version,name,replicas):return {'apiVersion':'training.example.com/'+version,'kind':'WebApp','metadata':{'name':name,'namespace':'training'},'spec':{'replicas':replicas}}
def patch(api,path,payload):
    status,obj=api.request('PATCH',path,payload,content_type='application/merge-patch+json');assert status==200,(status,obj);return obj
with ControlPlane() as api:
    legacy=copy.deepcopy(baseline)
    for v in legacy['spec']['versions']:v['storage']=v['name']=='v1beta1';v['served']=True
    api.create(CRDS,legacy);api.wait_crd(legacy['metadata']['name'])
    original=api.create(collection('v1beta1'),specobj('v1beta1','legacy',2));uid=original['metadata']['uid'];old_rv=original['metadata']['resourceVersion']
    # Apply the learner's version configuration to an actual existing API, not a fresh-empty model.
    current=api.get(CRD);request=copy.deepcopy(crd);request['metadata']['resourceVersion']=current['metadata']['resourceVersion']
    code,result=api.request('PUT',CRD,request);assert code==200,(code,result)
    until=time.monotonic()+8
    while time.monotonic()<until:
        current=api.get(CRD)
        if set(current.get('status',{}).get('storedVersions',[]))=={'v1','v1beta1'}:break
        time.sleep(.1)
    assert set(current['status']['storedVersions'])=={'v1','v1beta1'},current
    assert [(v['name'],v['storage']) for v in current['spec']['versions'] if v['storage']]==[('v1',True)]
    first=api.get(endpoint('v1'));second=api.get(endpoint('v1beta1'))
    assert first['apiVersion']=='training.example.com/v1' and second['apiVersion']=='training.example.com/v1beta1'
    assert first['metadata']['uid']==second['metadata']['uid']==uid
    assert first['metadata']['resourceVersion']==second['metadata']['resourceVersion']==old_rv
    assert first['spec']==second['spec']=={'replicas':2}
    stale=copy.deepcopy(second)
    changed=patch(api,endpoint('v1'),{'spec':{'replicas':5}})
    assert api.get(endpoint('v1beta1'))['spec']=={'replicas':5} and changed['metadata']['uid']==uid
    stale['spec']['replicas']=9;code,obj=api.request('PUT',endpoint('v1beta1'),stale);assert code==409,(code,obj)
    assert api.get(endpoint('v1'))['spec']=={'replicas':5}
    updated=api.get(endpoint('v1beta1'));updated['spec']['replicas']=7
    code,obj=api.request('PUT',endpoint('v1beta1'),updated);assert code==200,(code,obj)
    assert api.get(endpoint('v1'))['spec']=={'replicas':7}
    for version in ('v1','v1beta1'):
        created=api.create(collection(version),specobj(version,'new-'+version,3))
        other='v1' if version=='v1beta1' else 'v1beta1'
        assert api.get(endpoint(other,'new-'+version))['metadata']['uid']==created['metadata']['uid']
    # Rewriting this fixture does not automatically erase the historical storage-version marker.
    assert set(api.get(CRD)['status']['storedVersions'])=={'v1','v1beta1'}
    changed=copy.deepcopy(api.get(CRD)['spec']['versions'])
    for v in changed:
        if v['name']=='v1beta1':v['served']=False
    patch(api,CRD,{'spec':{'versions':changed}})
    until=time.monotonic()+8
    while time.monotonic()<until:
        status,obj=api.request('GET',endpoint('v1beta1'))
        if status==404:break
        time.sleep(.1)
    assert status==404,'Retired endpoint must stop serving'
    final=api.get(endpoint('v1'));assert final['spec']=={'replicas':7} and final['metadata']['uid']==uid
    assert set(api.get(CRD)['status']['storedVersions'])=={'v1','v1beta1'}
print('Native two-version API compatibility, shared identity/resourceVersion, optimistic conflict, retirement and retained storedVersions history passed; no general migration or conversion webhook claimed')

rubric: 说明一致性、权限或生命周期边界
body:
## 环境与初始材料
平台提供隔离API/etcd和默认化契约，初始配置将null语义颠倒且未给父对象默认值。

## 操作任务
修复crd.json的default/nullable策略：spec缺失或null时也得到完整默认配置；replicas缺失或null时为3，显式0必须保持；rollout缺失、null或空对象时batchSize为2，显式batchSize=null也按2处理；note缺失为auto，但显式null、空字符串必须保持。已有类型与范围不变（replicas 0..100、batchSize 1..20）。只修改spec、replicas、rollout、batchSize、note这五个schema位置的default/nullable，其他身份、schema和版本保持。文件小于32KiB，无重复JSON键。
平台自动准备无默认值的旧CRD及历史对象，再安装你的清单。验收创建/读取不同输入，以及默认值后来变化时旧对象“读取可见但尚未持久化”和明确PUT后的区别。你无需操作etcd或另开集群。只验真实API默认化和数据存储边界，不模拟未存在的控制器默认逻辑。

## 产物
crd.json完整清单。

## 验收方法
真实API创建/读取/更新，省略与null/0/空字符串组合、嵌套父对象默认、非法类型/范围拒绝、历史resourceVersion不变与显式PUT持久化。

files.fixtures/defaulting-contract.txt: replicas absent/null => 3, explicit 0 stays 0. rollout absent/null => object with batchSize 2. note absent => auto; explicit null and empty string preserved. Default read is not automatic storage migration.

import copy,hashlib,json,sys,time
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent))
from envtest_control_plane import ControlPlane
ROOT=Path.cwd();assert hashlib.sha256((ROOT/'fixtures/defaulting-contract.txt').read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='812cb51ae4d936c1f952f17ebc999a41012a004e4750a68d87844e782f51352c'
def pairs(items):
    out={}
    for k,v in items:assert k not in out,'duplicate JSON key';out[k]=v
    return out
p=ROOT/'crd.json';assert p.stat().st_size<32768;crd=json.loads(p.read_text(),object_pairs_hook=pairs);baseline={'apiVersion': 'apiextensions.k8s.io/v1', 'kind': 'CustomResourceDefinition', 'metadata': {'name': 'webapps.training.example.com'}, 'spec': {'group': 'training.example.com', 'scope': 'Namespaced', 'names': {'plural': 'webapps', 'singular': 'webapp', 'kind': 'WebApp'}, 'versions': [{'name': 'v1', 'served': True, 'storage': True, 'schema': {'openAPIV3Schema': {'type': 'object', 'properties': {'spec': {'type': 'object', 'properties': {'replicas': {'type': 'integer', 'minimum': 0, 'maximum': 100}, 'rollout': {'type': 'object', 'properties': {'batchSize': {'type': 'integer', 'minimum': 1, 'maximum': 20}}}, 'note': {'type': 'string'}}}}}}}]}}
def spec(d):return d['spec']['versions'][0]['schema']['openAPIV3Schema']['properties']['spec']
def invariant(d):
    d=copy.deepcopy(d);s=spec(d)
    for f in [s,s['properties']['replicas'],s['properties']['rollout'],s['properties']['rollout']['properties']['batchSize'],s['properties']['note']]:
        f.pop('default',None);f.pop('nullable',None)
    return json.dumps(d,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),allow_nan=False)
assert invariant(crd)==invariant(baseline),'Only the stated default/nullable policies may change'
CRDS='/apis/apiextensions.k8s.io/v1/customresourcedefinitions';CRD=CRDS+'/webapps.training.example.com';COL='/apis/training.example.com/v1/namespaces/training/webapps'
def obj(name,value):
    d={'apiVersion':'training.example.com/v1','kind':'WebApp','metadata':{'name':name,'namespace':'training'}}
    if value is not MISSING:d['spec']=value
    return d
MISSING=object()
def expected(replicas=3,batch=2,note='auto'):return {'replicas':replicas,'rollout':{'batchSize':batch},'note':note}
with ControlPlane() as api:
    api.create(CRDS,baseline);api.wait_crd(baseline['metadata']['name'])
    legacy=api.create(COL,obj('legacy',{}));legacy_rv=legacy['metadata']['resourceVersion'];uid=legacy['metadata']['uid']
    def install(candidate,wanted):
        value=copy.deepcopy(candidate);value['metadata']['resourceVersion']=api.get(CRD)['metadata']['resourceVersion']
        code,result=api.request('PUT',CRD,value);assert code==200,(code,result)
        until=time.monotonic()+8
        while time.monotonic()<until:
            status,result=api.request('POST',COL+'?dryRun=All',obj('schema-ready',{}))
            if status==201 and result.get('spec',{}).get('replicas')==wanted:return
            time.sleep(.1)
        raise AssertionError(('Defaulting policy did not become active',status,result))
    install(crd,3)
    positives=[(MISSING,expected()),(None,expected()),({},expected()),({'replicas':0},expected(0)),({'replicas':None},expected()),({'rollout':None},expected()),({'rollout':{}},expected()),({'rollout':{'batchSize':None}},expected()),({'rollout':{'batchSize':5}},expected(batch=5)),({'note':None},expected(note=None)),({'note':''},expected(note='')),({'replicas':9,'note':'explicit','rollout':{'batchSize':6}},expected(9,6,'explicit'))]
    for index,(request,wanted) in enumerate(positives):
        created=api.create(COL,obj('positive-'+str(index),request))
        assert created['spec']==wanted,(request,created,wanted)
        assert api.get(COL+'/positive-'+str(index))['spec']==wanted
    for invalid in ({'replicas':-1},{'replicas':101},{'replicas':'3'},{'replicas':True},{'rollout':{'batchSize':0}},{'rollout':{'batchSize':21}},{'rollout':'bad'},{'note':8}):
        status,result=api.request('POST',COL+'?dryRun=All',obj('invalid',invalid));assert status==422,(invalid,status,result)
    # Read defaults are visible without changing the stored object's resourceVersion.
    read=api.get(COL+'/legacy');assert read['spec']==expected() and read['metadata']['resourceVersion']==legacy_rv
    updated=copy.deepcopy(crd);spec(updated)['properties']['replicas']['default']=7;install(updated,7)
    reread=api.get(COL+'/legacy');assert reread['spec']==expected(7) and reread['metadata']['resourceVersion']==legacy_rv
    # Objects created while default3 was active already persisted that value.
    assert api.get(COL+'/positive-0')['spec']==expected()
    # Explicitly write the read object. A subsequent default change must not override it.
    code,saved=api.request('PUT',COL+'/legacy',reread);assert code==200,(code,saved)
    assert saved['metadata']['resourceVersion']!=legacy_rv and saved['metadata']['uid']==uid
    updated=copy.deepcopy(crd);spec(updated)['properties']['replicas']['default']=9;install(updated,9)
    persisted=api.get(COL+'/legacy');assert persisted['spec']==expected(7) and persisted['metadata']['uid']==uid
    assert api.create(COL,obj('new-default',{}))['spec']==expected(9)
print('Native request/read defaulting, nested parent activation, null preservation, explicit zero and update-only persistence passed; no controller or general data migration ran')
